Senior Full-Stack Engineer — Verdant Software (Remote)

Verdant Software is a seed-stage SaaS company building the next-generation sustainability reporting platform for enterprise clients. We have 12 engineers, are backed by $8M Seed round, and are growing fast. We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who can own features end-to-end across our React front-end, FastAPI Python backend, and PostgreSQL data layer.

About the Role

You will be the fifth member of our core product engineering team. You will work closely with our CTO and two senior engineers to ship new features, improve platform reliability, and scale our infrastructure as we grow from 50 to 500 enterprise customers. This is a high-ownership role — you will make architectural decisions, write the code, review your teammates' PRs, and ship to production multiple times per week.

Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain full-stack features in our Next.js 14 (App Router) + React front-end and Python/FastAPI REST API backend.
- Model and optimize PostgreSQL schemas; write complex SQL queries, manage Alembic migrations, and maintain data integrity as the platform scales.
- Contribute to our Docker-based CI/CD infrastructure (GitHub Actions) and ensure reliable deployments to our AWS environment.
- Participate actively in code review, architecture discussions (ADRs), and sprint planning.
- Mentor one mid-level engineer and contribute to engineering culture documentation.
- Collaborate asynchronously with a distributed team across Europe and Southeast Asia.

Required Skills

- 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.
- Expert-level proficiency in TypeScript, React, and Next.js (App Router strongly preferred).
- Strong Python skills with FastAPI or Django; experience with SQLAlchemy or equivalent ORM.
- Production PostgreSQL experience: query optimization, indexing, Alembic migrations.
- Experience with Docker, Docker Compose, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred).
- Comfortable with async-first remote collaboration (Slack, Notion, GitHub PRs).

Nice to Have

- Experience with pgvector or other vector databases for AI/ML features.
- Familiarity with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui component library.
- Prior experience at an early-stage startup (seed to Series B).
- Exposure to AI/LLM integrations (OpenAI API, Anthropic API, LangChain).

Compensation & Benefits

- $120k–$160k USD annual salary (or equivalent monthly rate for contractors).
- 0.1%–0.3% equity with 4-year vest, 1-year cliff.
- $2,000 equipment budget, $1,000/year learning & conference budget.
- Fully remote, async-first. No mandatory meetings before 09:00 UTC.
- 25 days PTO + local public holidays.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief note (3–5 sentences) on the most interesting technical problem you have solved in the past year to jess.thornton@verdantsoftware.com with subject 'Senior Full-Stack Engineer — [Your Name]'.

Senior AI Engineer — Nexus Labs (Remote)

Nexus Labs is building production-grade AI agent infrastructure for knowledge workers. Our flagship product is an agentic research assistant used daily by 8,000+ analysts at hedge funds and consulting firms. We have raised a $15M Series A and are expanding our core AI engineering team.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer with deep experience in LLM application development, RAG pipelines, and agent frameworks — specifically LangGraph. You will own critical components of our retrieval and generation pipeline, work on our Python/FastAPI backend, and occasionally contribute to the TypeScript/React front-end. This role requires someone who thinks carefully about latency, accuracy, and cost tradeoffs in production AI systems.

Responsibilities

- Design, implement, and optimize multi-node LangGraph agent workflows for document retrieval, synthesis, and structured output generation.
- Build and maintain our RAG pipeline: chunking strategies, embedding generation (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small, 1536-dim), pgvector cosine similarity search, keyword ILIKE fallback, and LLM-judge reranking.
- Write Python services (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Pydantic v2) that expose agent workflows as REST and SSE endpoints.
- Evaluate LLM outputs using RAGAS and custom evaluation harnesses; tune prompts, context windows, and retrieval parameters for accuracy.
- Collaborate with the product team to translate customer feedback into agent workflow improvements.
- Contribute to infrastructure: Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Railway deployment, PostgreSQL schema design.

Required Skills

- 3+ years of Python engineering experience in production environments.
- Deep hands-on experience with LangGraph or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen).
- Production RAG pipeline experience: chunking, embedding (1536-dim preferred), vector store retrieval, reranking.
- PostgreSQL and pgvector for semantic search; comfort with SQL query optimization.
- FastAPI + Pydantic v2 + SQLAlchemy 2.0 for API development.
- Strong understanding of LLM providers: OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4 Turbo), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), token economics.
- Docker and CI/CD for containerized Python services.

Nice to Have

- Experience with TypeScript/React for occasional front-end contributions.
- Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval).
- Background in information retrieval (BM25, dense retrieval, hybrid search).
- Prior work with streaming responses (SSE or WebSockets) from LLM backends.

Compensation & Benefits

- $130k–$180k USD / year.
- 0.15%–0.5% equity with 4-year vest.
- Remote-first, async-first culture. Overlap with EU and US-East preferred but Manila timezone is welcome.
- $2,500 equipment budget, unlimited conference/course budget for AI-related learning.
- Health and wellness stipend $200/month.

To Apply

Apply at nexuslabs.ai/careers/senior-ai-engineer or email priya@nexuslabs.ai with your resume and a brief description of a RAG or agent system you have shipped to production.

Web3 Product Engineer — Chainworks Protocol (Remote, DeFi)

Chainworks Protocol is building decentralized infrastructure for on-chain derivatives trading on Ethereum and Base. We have $12M TVL, 1,200 active traders, and a core team of 9 engineers distributed across Singapore, Berlin, and Manila. We are seeking a Web3 Product Engineer who can write production Solidity smart contracts and ship the React/Next.js front-end that traders interact with every day.

About the Role

This is a full-stack Web3 role. You will write Solidity, deploy contracts, integrate them into a Next.js + wagmi v2 front-end, and maintain the Python/FastAPI event indexer that keeps our PostgreSQL database in sync with on-chain state. You are expected to own entire product features from smart contract design to UI, with support from the rest of the team.

Responsibilities

- Write, test, and deploy Solidity smart contracts (ERC-20, custom AMM logic, settlement contracts) using Foundry. Maintain and upgrade existing contracts with UUPS proxy patterns.
- Integrate smart contracts into the React + Next.js + TypeScript front-end using wagmi v2 and viem. Build wallet connection flows (RainbowKit/WalletConnect), transaction status tracking, and gas estimation UIs.
- Maintain and extend the Python/FastAPI event indexer: listen to on-chain events via WebSocket (Alchemy), parse and persist to PostgreSQL, expose REST APIs for the front-end.
- Write comprehensive Foundry tests including unit tests, fuzz tests, and invariant tests for all Solidity contracts. Achieve and maintain 90%+ Solidity test coverage.
- Collaborate on security reviews; participate in external audits when required.
- Contribute to technical documentation: NatSpec comments, integration guides, and deployment runbooks.

Required Skills

- 2+ years of Solidity development experience with production mainnet deployments.
- Foundry proficiency: forge, cast, anvil, invariant testing.
- React and TypeScript: modern React patterns, TypeScript strict mode, component design.
- Next.js for the front-end (App Router preferred).
- wagmi v2 / viem / ethers.js for blockchain interaction from the frontend.
- Python for the event indexer: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL.
- Understanding of DeFi primitives: AMMs, liquidity pools, price oracles, settlement logic.

Nice to Have

- Experience with Ethereum Layer-2 chains (Base, Optimism, Arbitrum).
- Familiarity with Chainlink oracles and TWAP price feeds.
- OpenZeppelin Contracts v5 upgrade patterns.
- Prior experience at a DeFi protocol or Web3 gaming company.
- Knowledge of AI/LLM integrations for on-chain data analysis.

Compensation & Benefits

- $100k–$150k USD / year base.
- Token allocation: 0.2%–0.6% of protocol token supply, 3-year vest with 6-month cliff.
- Fully remote, no mandatory all-hands outside UTC+0 to UTC+9 business hours.
- $1,500 equipment budget, $500/year Ethereum mainnet gas reimbursement for testing.
- Discretionary time off.

To Apply

Send your GitHub profile or any public smart contract code (mainnet or testnet) to daniel@chainworks.io. Include a 2–3 sentence description of the most interesting DeFi mechanism you have implemented.
